title: Glass Shelf 16-Inch Wall Mount Triple Tier With Towel Bar Solid Brass | Oil Rubbed Bronze | Allied Brass
short_title: Glass Shelf 16-Inch Triple Tier With Towel Bar | Allied Brass
description:
Add organized storage to your bathroom with a 16-Inch wall mount glass shelf featuring three tiers and an integrated towel bar in Oil Rubbed Bronze, which offers rich, dark brown tones with subtle copper highlights, bringing Old World character to any bathroom. Built with solid brass hardware and 3/8-inch thick tempered glass for strength and everyday use.

Highlights:
- Oil Rubbed Bronze brings rich depth and character
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- 3/8-inch thick tempered glass with beveled edges for safety and a finished look
- Solid brass hardware with concealed screw mounting
- Multiple finish options available, including statement colors

Specs:
- Glass dimensions: 16 x 5 Inches
- Overall size: 16-Inch L x 5-Inch W x 18-Inch H
- Weight capacity: 6 lb
- Mounting: wall mount; concealed screws
- Assembly: not required
- Included: glass shelf and all installation hardware (screws #8 x 1 1/4)
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
